Vapid._note: Web Push (OS notifications when app is closed). VAPID key pair — the SAME pair must stay across deploys or existing device subscriptions break. Public key is exposed to the browser via /api/push/vapid-public-key. Override on server with VAPID_PUBLIC_KEY / VAPID_PRIVATE_KEY / VAPID_SUBJECT env vars if preferred. Regenerate with: node gen_vapid.js
